job.title: Account Coordinator - Experiential Marketing - Entry Level
job.description:
Are you ready to kick-start your career in the dynamic worlds of media, advertising and marketing? If so, this opportunity could be for you…

Who is Flaunt?
Our mission at Flaunt is to support those at the start of their careers in finding roles and companies where they can unleash their true selves, uncover their paths, and thrive.

Whether you’ve studied these fields or not, Flaunt exists to arm you with the education, inspiration, and support to make the best possible choices for your future. We look beyond resumes, focusing on strengths and potential, and continue supporting you with coaching and mentorship throughout your first year in the role.

We specialise in the media, marketing and advertising space - from strategy to planning, investment to sales, client management to data and insights. Whatever your background, this high-energy, progressive industry will have you working alongside some of the biggest brands in the world.

We know traditional recruitment processes can be daunting, especially when you don’t have lots of experience. That’s why our process, including our unique Discovery Days are designed to bring out your strengths in a fun and supportive group setting.

You’ll meet industry experts from a range of backgrounds, hear how they built their careers, and see what life is like in a multitude of roles first-hand. It’s about learning more about yourself, exploring the industry, and discovering what path excites you most.

Our commitment doesn’t stop once you’re placed. Starting your first full-time role can be overwhelming, so we pair every successful candidate with an industry coach for your first six months. Whether it’s building your personal brand, navigating tricky conversations, or developing confidence, you’ll have guidance from someone who’s been there and wants you to thrive.

About this Role:
This Coordinator role is for someone at the start of their career who’s hungry to learn, loves rolling up their sleeves, and wants to create brand experiences that make people stop, feel, and remember. If you’re keen to dive into agency life and help bring brands to life in the real world, we’d love to hear from you.

As an Account Coordinator, you’ll:
  • Support the end-to-end delivery of live brand experiences - from quirky pop-ups to big event activations.
  • Help with project planning, supplier coordination, venue logistics, and on-the-ground execution.
  • Work closely with creatives, producers, and account teams to make ideas happen.
  • Assist with budget tracking, timelines, and post-event reporting.
  • Be part of brainstorms to develop fresh, unexpected ways to connect brands with real people.
  • Learn how to turn bold ideas into reality and see first-hand how strategy, creativity, and logistics collide to create memorable moments.

You Might Be:
  • A recent graduate or soon-to-be grad
  • A natural organiser who loves a good list but also knows how to pivot when the unexpected happens
  • A people person who builds rapport easily and keeps their cool under pressure
  • From a background in marketing, communications, business, hospitality, performing arts - or anywhere else that’s given you transferable skills and a service mindset
  • New to the workforce and figuring out what’s next - and that’s completely okay


If you want to work in an environment that rewards ideas and gives you a front-row seat to how brands make an impact in this world, this could be your perfect first step. This is one of several similar entry-level roles we are recruiting for currently and we are excited to help you discover your best-fit path in a creative, fast-paced and people-driven industry.

Please click Apply and upload your resume and we will be in touch with next steps.

We can’t wait to meet you.

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
About Hylink Australia
Hylink is a global full-service advertising agency, blending creativity, culture, and strategy to deliver meaningful campaigns for brands across automotive, lifestyle, luxury, and technology.

In Australia, we're growing fast. Our Sydney team is small, collaborative, and ambitious - backed by the scale and support of Hylink's 20+ offices around the world. We work on everything from social content to full-scale brand campaigns, with a mix of local and international clients who trust us to bring fresh thinking and flawless execution.

The Opportunity
We're looking for an Account Manager to join our Sydney team and take the lead on one of our key clients in the automotive sector.
This role is ideal for someone who's confident managing client relationships, loves working with creative teams, and enjoys seeing campaigns come to life - from first idea to final delivery. You'll be supported by a strong senior team but trusted to make things happen and build real client partnerships.

What You'll Do
Client Relationships
  • Be the main point of contact for our key automotive client and its affiliated brands.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders; you'll be in their offices 1–2 days a week.
  • Help shape campaign strategies and social plans that make a difference.
  • Work closely with our creative and production teams to deliver work that looks great and performs even better.
Project Management
  • Keep projects moving; manage briefs, timelines, budgets, and approvals.
  • Coordinate across teams so everyone's aligned and deadlines are met.
  • Make sure everything we produce feels on-brand, on-brief, and on time.
Growth & Collaboration
  • Support new project proposals and pitches when opportunities arise.
  • Spot ways to grow existing accounts through smart thinking and initiative.
Contribute to a positive, collaborative culture where everyone's ideas are valued.

What You'll Bring
  • 2+ years' experience in an account management or client service role within an advertising, marketing, or creative agency.
  • Strong understanding of social media, digital marketing, and creative campaign delivery.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills (you're great with people).
  • The ability to juggle multiple projects without dropping the ball.
  • Organised, detail-oriented, and proactive (you get things done).
  • Experience in preparing proposals or campaign decks.
  • Must have permanent residency or Australian citizenship to be eligible for this position.

A Bit About You
You're someone who thrives in a fast-moving creative environment. You enjoy the buzz of agency life, collaborating with great people, and seeing campaigns out in the world. You're curious, adaptable, and genuinely care about doing good work, the kind that clients value and audiences notice.

What's in It for You
  • Hybrid flexibility – work from home one day a week, with our North Sydney office as your creative base.
  • Work with global and local brands, with the potential for overseas travel.
  • Get hands-on across a variety of projects, from quick social turnarounds to full-scale brand campaigns.
  • Collaborate with talented people across creative, strategy, and production.
  • A growing agency means real opportunities to shape your career.
  • Competitive salary $80,000–$100,000 + super (depending on experience).
  • Extra perks like team events and access to global training and development.

www.hylink.com.au
